Sets the light channels an entity is lit by. A channel is one bit of `channel`, so there are 8 of them (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64 and 128) and the values add up: 3 is channel 1 and 2. The entity is only lit by the lights that share at least one channel with it, see [LightChannel](LightChannel). 0 means no light reaches it. The default is 255, all channels. Meshes, sprites and terrains all use it, and the channel of an entity is not passed on to its children.

[AmbientLight](AmbientLight) is not a light of any channel: it lights every entity, and an entity with [EntityFX](EntityFX) 1 ignores lights anyway.

Which lights count is decided per entity: only the lights that share a channel with it are considered, and the 8 of them that matter the most to it light it (see [Many-Lights](Many-Lights)). Lights of other channels never use up one of the 8.

```blitzbasic
;media still blitz3d/entitylightchannel.png
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
camera = CreateCamera()
PositionEntity camera, 0, 0, -9
AmbientLight 10, 10, 10
light = CreateLight(2)
PositionEntity light, 0, 3, -3
LightChannel light, 2
; Only the ball in the middle is in the channel of the light.
For i = 0 To 2
	ball = CreateSphere(24)
	PositionEntity ball, i * 3 - 3, 0, 0
	If i = 1 Then EntityLightChannel ball, 2 Else EntityLightChannel ball, 1
Next
RenderWorld
Flip
WaitKey
```

![EntityLightChannel](media/blitz3d/entitylightchannel.png)

This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals have no light channels.
@param entity   Entity handle.
@param channel  The channels as bits (0 to 255): bit 0 is channel 1 up to bit 7 for channel 8.
